name: life-jacket
description: A life jacket with two broad padded front panels and a complete waist strap.
useCase: Identify life jackets or personal flotation equipment.
misuse: Use a visible label when equipment identifies a product, outdoor activity or required gear.

16.reason: Two broad front panels remain open above the full waist strap.

24.reason: The larger life jacket keeps both front panels and the complete waist strap clear.
